issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Two Minnesota Men Plead Guilty to Defrauding Medicaid Housing Services Program
notes: Retrieved from the official USAO-MN host during the 2026-10-06 public-freshness sweep. The release gives two individual guilty-plea events and does not provide a program-wide HSS conviction ordinal.
supports: Hassan Ahmed Hussein entered a guilty plea on September 24, 2026 to one count of wire fraud.
Ahmed Abdirashid Mohamed entered a guilty plea on October 1, 2026 to one count of wire fraud.
The defendants operated Pristine Health LLC and the release states that the company billed Minnesota Medicaid more than $820,000.
The release states that the two defendants defrauded the HSS program out of more than $500,000 by submitting fraudulent claims for services that were never provided.
does_not_support: A program-wide HSS charged, convicted, or sentenced ordinal.
A final sentence for either defendant; sentencing was to be set later.
